semantic_group.pooling_rule: compact-policy and paper-corrected-training profiles are reported separately; their observations may share only the exact source-problem case axis

profile_records.claim_boundary: RPSO-derived compact policy engineering proxy; no source replay, full PPO, or RLPSO reproduction claim.
Paper-corrected seeded PPO training reconstruction with complete physical-FES ledger; no author checkpoint, literal source replay, or reported-result reproduction claim.

physical_fes_definition: one complete rpso2024_source_problem_ws1_ws4_v1 layout evaluation; policy-training evaluations plus inference evaluations equal exactly 24000 total physical FES per run

execution.cpu_work_partition: one persistent 20-worker team partitions population construction, repair, and independent complete-layout evaluation; policy updates and ordered selection remain deterministic

rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.generator: seeded online linear categorical actor with immediate-reward policy-gradient updates
rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.seed_source: optimization seed with a domain-separated compact-policy training event namespace
rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.artifact_hash: record the final learned-state hash per run; no reusable author checkpoint
rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.training_physical_fes: record exact runtime count of action-reward complete-layout evaluations
rlpso_compact_policy_declared_reconstruc.inference_physical_fes: record exact runtime count of initialization, exemplar-trial, and updated-population complete-layout evaluations

rlpso_paper_corrected_training_reconstru.generator: one seeded persistent 2-256-64 actor-critic with Adam and paper-corrected PPO updates per optimization run
rlpso_paper_corrected_training_reconstru.seed_source: optimization seed with domain-separated network-initialization, rollout, and action event namespaces
rlpso_paper_corrected_training_reconstru.artifact_hash: record FNV-1a-64 over ordered actor and critic parameters per run; no author checkpoint
rlpso_paper_corrected_training_reconstru.training_physical_fes: record exact runtime count of every PPO action-reward complete-layout evaluation
rlpso_paper_corrected_training_reconstru.inference_physical_fes: record exact runtime count of initialization, exemplar-trial, and updated-population complete-layout evaluations

resume_policy.atomic_commit: write same-filesystem temporary result, flush and fsync, then rename
